title: Orient Anything V2: Unifying Orientation and Rotation Understanding
summary: A symmetry-aware foundation model for object orientation, relative rotation, and rotational-symmetry understanding from single or paired images.

mechanisms.name: Symmetry-aware paired-image relative orientation
mechanisms.description: Model zero-to-many valid front-facing modes with a periodic symmetry-aware objective and use paired images to estimate relative object rotation instead of forcing one canonical front.
inputs: single or paired object RGB crops
mechanisms.limitations: General orientation and benchmark pose results do not establish the owner-canonical sibling coordinate required by BlindAssist, especially for symmetric or front-undefined object groups.
